source.author: verg
source.text: ipse ego paulisper pro te tua munera inibo.
source.text_original: ipse ego paulisper pro te tua munera inibo.'
source.text_english: I myself will undertake your duties for a little while on your behalf.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: non nuntia tantum fama refert: ipsum iuvenem tam saeva gementem, ipsum ego, cum serus fessos sopor alligat artus, aspicio; lacera assiduis namque illius umbra questibus et magni numen maris excitat Helle.
reuse.text_original: non nuntia tantum / fama refert: ipsum iuvenem tam saeva gementem, / ipsum ego, cum serus fessos sopor alligat artus, / aspicio; lacera assiduis namque illius umbra / questibus et magni numen maris excitat Helle.
reuse.text_english: Report does not bring only tidings: I myself behold the young man, groaning so fiercely, I myself, when late sleep binds weary limbs, do I see him; for Helle, torn by constant laments, and the divinity of the great sea, rouses his shade.
